reason: Fresh OSS-first successor for Product Experience PR #229 after the shared packaged Node runtime was ordinary-merged as 943d9339ff80ceb34903cb861c225625b50769ec. The existing Product Final Validation still hands the user a Round12/13 source-UAT package whose Windows runner installs dependencies on the user machine, and the Matrix compose authority still uses local Docker build contexts. A real Windows UAT already demonstrated why that architecture is unstable: node-pty may fall back to node-gyp/native compilation and inherit ambient toolchain state. This package retires that Product-specific delivery route without rewriting the generic legacy source-UAT framework. Trusted CI must materialize two sealed artifacts bound to the same Product commit/tree: a Windows desktop bundle assembled through the existing WP7 trusted-product/Node/Parlant/Electron seams, and a Linux Matrix image bundle built from the already-pinned Synapse/Element/mautrix sources with the existing Element official runtime-module patch. The user machine may only verify hashes/identity, docker load the sealed images, docker compose up with --no-build, extract the already-built desktop payload, clone existing Yance data into an isolated UAT data root if requested, launch Yance.exe, and collect UAT evidence. User-machine npm, pnpm, node-gyp, Docker build, Visual Studio, Windows SDK, Spectre libraries, source compilation, and dependency resolution are forbidden.

supersedes.reason: The superseded architecture still performs npm ci on the UAT machine. The new OSS-first policy requires retiring that user-machine build path instead of trying to hermetically prolong it.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, discard invalid paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing. The exact path arrays remain the admission authority even when this authorization omits a redundant precomputed digest.

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: On the exact authorization-merge baseline, tests/wp0/v21-product-experience-materialized-uat.test.js must be the only implementation change and Stage npm run test:wp0 must fail causally because Product Final Validation still invokes create-round12-13-windows-uat-package.js and the materialized Product candidate/runner/image-only compose files do not exist.

The repaired Product Final Validation must not invoke create-round12-13-windows-uat-package.js, start-source-uat.js, npm ci on the UAT machine, or any Product user-machine dependency preparation path.

The candidate creator must seal every staged regular file by normalized relative path, byte size and SHA-256, reject symlinks/path escape/duplicate identities, and bind branch/commit/tree plus bundle class; it must not become a generic build/download/package manager.

The Product runner must verify both bundle manifests and all file records before execution, require exact matching branch/commit/tree, reject extra or modified payload files, invoke docker load and docker compose up --no-build only, and never invoke npm, pnpm, node-gyp or docker build.
The Product image-only compose file must contain image references for Synapse, Element and mautrix-whatsapp and must contain zero build keys.

The Windows desktop CI path must produce a WP7 PRE_REVIEW_ONLY already-built application payload using Node 22.23.1, reviewed production dependencies, official Electron and presealed Parlant before artifact upload.
The Linux Matrix CI path must build pinned candidate-tagged images from tools/matrix/bootstrap.js materialization and export them with docker save before artifact upload.

No Product runtime/UI, generic source-UAT framework, root dependency manifest, root lockfile, Matrix bootstrap implementation, Element patch, WP7 implementation or third-party Action registry change is authorized.

handoffBackToProduct.rule: After this root-migration implementation ordinary-merges to main, ordinary-forward merge fresh main into the Product branch without rebase or history rewrite. The six materialized-UAT paths become base-owned. Product Final Validation must then generate both sealed same-identity artifacts on the fresh Product Head, followed by real Windows UAT. Only after UAT and all fresh Product gates are GREEN may PR #229 reach its final integration merge boundary.
